messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Paging: Elevated gateway 504/502 spike in us-west-2 affecting batch scheduler. Alert triggered at 2026-03-15T14:12:03Z
alex: I'm on it. seeing 5xx spike on gateway behind router-A. p50 latency up 3x. errors predominantly 504/timeouts.
mira: Any customer-facing errors reported? Support queue has 5 notes about timeouts from customer "AtlasPay".
alex: logs:
```
[2026-03-15T14:11:58Z] gateway-A1 -> 504 Gateway Timeout - batch-scheduler-queue-depth=128
[2026-03-15T14:12:00Z] batcher-12 takeBatch failed: timeout=120s waiting on kv-cache lookup
```
alex: Looks like batcher backlog + kv-cache slow responses causing head-of-line blocking. queue depth climbing.
jordan: @alex take primary oncall, i'm switching to SRE lead. I'll spin up mitigation steps. enable live routing fallback to single-request path?
alex: yes enabling fallback to non-batched router now. Command:
```
bin/routerctl set-route-priority --router=us-west-2 --policy=fallback-single
```
ops-bot: Executing: bin/routerctl set-route-priority --router=us-west-2 --policy=fallback-single
ops-bot: OK - route policy changed (txn 0x3f4b)
mira: enabling aggressive batch eviction for older requests to free head-of-line. Patch config:
```
batcher.eviction.age_ms=300
batcher.eviction.priority=LRU
```
alex: applied eviction, decreasing batch window from 50ms -> 20ms to reduce coalescing
ops-bot: Config reload triggered for batcher service in us-west-2
jordan: scaling batch scheduler pool +2 nodes
ops-bot: Autoscaler request accepted: +2 nodes pending
support-ana: notified AtlasPay support reps; offering workaround: retry 1s then fall back to synchronous endpoint
alex: After changes, error rate dropped 40% over 2 minutes, p95 latency improving but still elevated for long-stream requests. KV cache latency still 2.2s on some hosts.
mira: Tracing shows hot KV shards on host kv-7. I recommend draining kv-7 and failing it out of pool.
jordan: initiating drain on kv-7
ops-bot: Drain command sent to kv-7, start migrating shards
alex: applying circuit-breaker on gateway-A1 to limit inflight batch requests to 30
ops-bot: Applied cb policy (id cb-20260315-1)
alex: Observability: dashboard link - https://redwood/obs/dashboards/incident/4367890123
sre-lead: Any customer impact estimate? support-ana?
support-ana: two paying customers reported failures (AtlasPay + CognitoX). AtlasPay transaction failures ~0.7% of their traffic in the incident window. CognitoX had higher timeouts on long-chains.
jordan: ok, escalate to P1? We have active mitigation and partial rollback to single-request path. Marking P1 for now.
alex: note: rolling back a recent KV client bump from v1.9.2->v1.10.0 might help. There's a suspect change in connection pooling.
mira: rolling client back on a canary node now.
ops-bot: Job launched: rollback kv-client on kv-proxy-canary
alex: after rollbacks + evictions + routing changes error rate stabilized near baseline over ~8 minutes. p99 spikes rare. Keeping monitoring for 30m.
jordan: good runbook updates:
- add alert for kv-cache shard latency >1s
- add runbook step to toggle fallback-single route
- document batcher.eviction tuning ranges
alex: ephemeral: will open postmortem and assign owners. creating incident ticket.
ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-20260315-0843
support-ana: customer comms draft: "We're investigating elevated timeouts; we've applied mitigations and are monitoring. More updates in 30m." :thumbsup:
jordan: handing off to oncall for monitoring window. @alex remain on standby for rollback if needed.
alex: standing by. will update if metrics regress.
mira: thanks all. closing thread after 30m stable.
Incident Bot: :white_check_mark: Incident status: mitigated, monitoring (artifact: INC-20260315-0843)
